jobs.description:
Du bist jemand, der gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Projekte von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss begleitet? Bei uns wirst du zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kunden, steuerst deren Projekte und trägst aktiv dazu bei, Leuchtturmprojekte zu schaffen, die unser Wachstum vorantreiben. Du suchst eine neue Herausforderung in einem ambitionierten Team auf dem Weg, die 360° Plattform für die Energiewende weiterzuentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It’s a role with real ownership, where your decisions matter and you can see their impact directly in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You work with the relevant team members to ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

  • You have ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

  • You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

This role is based in our Munich or Nuremberg office, with at least 3 days per week on site.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days yearly working remotely from a different location, in line with our workation policy.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special occasions like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team events where we work, unwind, and connect. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process:

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and Head of Product & Engineering, Alex, at one of our offices.

  4. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview with our CEO, Felix.

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustments to participate in an interview or assessment, please let our recruitment team know so we can discuss suitable arrangements.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

jobs.title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.

You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.

You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible?

You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

  • Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

  • Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

  • Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

  • Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

  • Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

  • Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

  • Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

  • Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

  • Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

  • Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

  • Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output.

  • UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use.

  • Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself.

  • Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront.

  • Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact.

  • Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build.

  • AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

  • High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

  • Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

  • Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.

About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg.


Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.

These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

  • Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

  • Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

  • Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

  • Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

  • AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

  • Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.


The Team

You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

  • A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

  • Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

  • Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

  • Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

  • Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

  • Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.


Who you are

  • Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

  • Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

  • Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

  • Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

  • Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

  • You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.


Recruitment process

  1. First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

  2. Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

  3. Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

  4. Meet the CEO.

  5. Reference check

  6. Offer

What You Get  

Competitive compensation  

  • 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview)   

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact  

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.  

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

 

Here’s what our users say:  

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★  

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★  

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

jobs.title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Safety & Compliance

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.

If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

  • Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

  • Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

  • Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

  • Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS.

  • You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

  • You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

  • You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

  • You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

  • You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

  • You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

  • You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

  • You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

Nice to have:

  • Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

  • Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

  • Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

  • Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

 

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

 

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Owner Digital Customer Platform
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan het digitale fundament van de volgende generatie Mijn Independer. Wil jij richting geven aan een platform waarop miljoenen veilige en betrouwbare klantinteracties plaatsvinden? Lees dan verder.

Wat ga je doen als Product Owner Digital Customer Platform?
Als Product Owner Digital Customer Platform ben je verantwoordelijk voor één van de belangrijkste platformteams binnen Independer. Je geeft richting aan het digitale fundament van Mijn Independer 2.0 en vertaalt complexe technische vraagstukken naar een heldere productvisie, duidelijke prioriteiten en concrete resultaten. Met jouw werk maak je veilige, betrouwbare en schaalbare klantinteracties mogelijk en creëer je de basis voor personalisatie, AI-oplossingen en toekomstige digitale dienstverlening. Zonder deze rol ontbreekt de technische basis waarop nieuwe klantfunctionaliteiten gebouwd worden.

Concreet ga jij aan de slag met:
Je werkt op het snijvlak van productontwikkeling, architectuur, security, data en engineering. Daarbij houd jij je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het bepalen en uitdragen van de productvisie voor het Digital Customer Platform.

  • Het prioriteren van de backlog in samenwerking met architecten, tech leads en andere stakeholders.

  • Het aansturen van ontwikkelingen rondom digitale identiteit, autorisaties, klantidentificatie, accountbeheer en personalisatie.

  • Het realiseren van de integratie van nieuwe platformdiensten, waaronder CIAM-oplossingen, en het bewaken van technische kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit en ontwikkelsnelheid.

  • Het vertalen van strategische ambities naar een uitvoerbare roadmap en het vinden van de juiste balans tussen innovatie, technische schuld en operationele betrouwbaarheid.

Team
Dit doe je uiteraard niet alleen, maar samen met een groep gezellige en gedreven collega's. Je werkt intensief samen met teams binnen Data & AI, Mijn Independer Frontend, Customer Experience, Architectuur en Security. Samen bouwen jullie aan de technische basis van Mijn Independer en ontwikkelen jullie oplossingen voor digitale identiteit, authenticatie, autorisaties, klantidentificatie, accountkoppelingen, personalisatie en AI-gedreven dienstverlening. Daarnaast werkt het team continu aan het verbeteren van stabiliteit, performance, developer experience en het verminderen van technische schuld.

Wat wij bieden

  • Salaris tot max 6.300 euro o.b.v. 40 uur, vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus;

  • 30 vakantiedagen en een premievrij pensioen;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en een thuiswerk- en internetvergoeding;

  • De mogelijkheid om voor 50% vanuit huis te werken;

  • In de winter in de zon werken? Ga een aantal weken op workation;

  • Veel ruimte om te groeien en ontwikkelen d.m.v. ons brede opleidingsaanbod;

  • Leuke events, borrels en sportactiviteiten;

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide en gezonde lunch;

  • Een fijn kantoor met gratis parkeergelegenheid en station Hilversum op loopafstand;

  • En natuurlijk een bedrijf vol enthousiaste collega's!

Wat wij zoeken
Je voelt je thuis in een complexe platformomgeving en weet technologie, business en klantwaarde met elkaar te verbinden. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager.

  • Ervaring met digitale platformen, SaaS-producten of klantplatformen en affiniteit met software-architectuur en technische vraagstukken.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe organisatie en een analytische, datagedreven manier van werken.

  • Je begrijpt hoe moderne platformen, API's, identity-oplossingen en cloudomgevingen werken, zonder zelf developer te hoeven zijn.

  • Je durft keuzes te maken, prioriteiten te stellen en strategische ambities te vertalen naar een heldere roadmap.

Waarom juist Independer?
In deze rol werk je aan de technische ruggengraat van één van de belangrijkste strategische initiatieven binnen Independer. De keuzes die jij maakt hebben directe invloed op de snelheid waarmee nieuwe klantfunctionaliteiten ontwikkeld worden, de veiligheid van klantgegevens en de mogelijkheden om AI, personalisatie en nieuwe dienstverlening succesvol in te zetten. Je werkt nauw samen met senior stakeholders uit Product, Data & AI, Technologie en Architectuur en levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de toekomst van Mijn Independer.

Het DNA van Independer kenmerkt zich door optimisme, klantgerichtheid en actief samenwerken. Dit zie je terug in een werkomgeving waar je volledig jezelf kunt zijn, zelf de regie hebt over je professionele ontwikkeling en alle vrijheid krijgt om je werk naar eigen inzicht uit te voeren. Daarnaast werk je op een plek waar je in de pauzes kunt poolen of tafeltennissen, én krijg je de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

We mogen onszelf officieel een Great Place to Work noemen. We hebben de titel gekregen van onze collega's en Great Place to Work Nederland. Wat dat inhoudt? Onze collega's noemen dit een fijne organisatiecultuur waar ze met veel plezier, vertrouwen en trots willen werken.

Interesse? Solliciteer direct!
Ben je enthousiast geworden en herken je jezelf in bovenstaand profiel? Klik dan op de knop 'Solliciteren' en wie weet zien we jou snel op ons kantoor in Hilversum.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams

Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces.

Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product.

Jouw impact als Product Owner

Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Wat je doet

  • Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt.

  • Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang.

  • Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX.

  • Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten.

  • Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang.

  • Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden.

Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten.

Wie ben jij?

Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen


Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS

  • Je hebt een 'AI-first' mindset en gebruikt AI (zoals Claude) handig voor het ontwikkelen van prototypes en het opzetten van features.

  • Je hebt meerdere squads tegelijk begeleid in een multidisciplinaire omgeving met development, design en business

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en durft nee te zeggen als het product daar beter van wordt

  • Je werkt vanzelfsprekend agile (Scrum of Kanban) en kent tools als Jira of Productboard

  • Je beslist op basis van data en klantinzichten, niet op onderbuikgevoel

  • Je woont in of rondom Utrecht en werkt minimaal 3 dagen per week op ons kantoor

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring)

  • Een duidelijk groeipad naar Senior Product Owner

  • Bij contractverlening de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een aandelenregeling

  • Een MacBook en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen

  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

  • Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day: 10%, waarvan wij 50% bijdragen

  • Een jaarlijks persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 (o.b.v. fulltime)

  • Een ambitieuze, internationale werkomgeving (meer dan 7 culturen!) waar we elkaar scherp houden én successen vieren

Uiteindelijk komen we maar op één manier erachter of het klikt? Solliciteer snel en dan drinken we een (digitale) kop koffie!

jobs.title: AI Product Manager - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers.

You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process.

You’ll have a lot of ownership and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

  • Prioritize AI product improvements based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and data.

  • AI-Savviness: Stay up to date with developments in generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and related technologies and identify relevant opportunities for Reonic.

  • Own release testing: Coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and provide clear, actionable feedback to engineering.

  • Coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams.

  • Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience.

  • Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate issues, reproduce problems, and translate findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering.

  • Communicate what's new: Create release notes, run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works.

  • Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers.

  • Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to make better product decisions.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful.

  • Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems.

  • Strong communication: You can clearly communicate with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C2) is required.

  • Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren't afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts.

  • Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem that you can help solve yourself.

  • Startup mindset: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built.

  • Relevant experience: Experience in product management, product operations, QA, software development, B2B SaaS, or a similar role is a plus. A degree in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is also helpful, but not required.

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

  • High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

  • Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

  • Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.


About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg.


Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
jobs.description:
Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter.

At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe. No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer.

We are a high-growth European scale-up, backed by €43M from world-class investors, on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here.

At our core, we’re a tech company. We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair.

We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do.


What you'll be doing:

Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio. This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance.

Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.


What you’ll be up to (some examples):
  • Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.
  • Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.
  • Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.
  • Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.
    • This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

    Specifically, you bring:
  • 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.
  • Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.
  • Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).
  • Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

    • Who this is not for:
  • You prioritize a 40-hour work week: We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week.
  • You prefer your comfort zone: We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here.
  • You prefer to stay high-level: While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit.
  • A steep learning curve feels daunting: We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months.

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.
  • In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam.
  • Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy.
  • Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team.
  • Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe.

    • Our culture (read this carefully)

    We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader. That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace.

    Our culture is defined by three things:

  • High ownership
    People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it.
  • High pace
    Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection.
  • High standards
     Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through.

    • At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone.

    We believe great work happens through close collaboration. We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface.

    This is a human-sized company. You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset.

    We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here.

    If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront.

jobs.title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)
Senior Product Manager (Towed Array Solutions)
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 

As Senior Product Manager Towed Array Solutions you join our towed array product group as its second Product Manager, as we expand the team to keep pace with our current growth. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support.

You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

  • Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems.

  • Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software.

  • Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team.

  • Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness.

  • Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering.

  • Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution.

  • Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS.

  • In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience with sonar, towed arrays or underwater acoustics, ideally in ASW or ISR applications, is a big plus.

  • Experience with naval surface vessel programs, ideally submarine or special warfare support missions.

  • Experience with defense procurement, naval platform integration and export-controlled products.

  • Experience with fiber optic sensing technology.

  • Proficiency in tooling such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, BigPicture, JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, Miro and PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Identity Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Identity Product Manager to drive the authentication, authorization, and access management capabilities that let every user, from an individual developer to the largest regulated enterprise, get into Sonar products securely and without friction. You will work with the Identity squad, in the Storefront domain, which provides the operational foundation enabling seamless customer access to Sonar's products, underpinning core business processes such as billing and entitlement.

This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, security, and compliance. As a Product Manager, you will shape how organizations authenticate into Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, with enterprise identity providers such as Okta and Entra ID), how permissions and roles are managed at scale, and how user and organization identities are provisioned and kept secure throughout their lifecycle. To achieve this, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, and prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, security teams, and enterprise buyers, and translate those needs across our product line.

You will join the Product Management team, composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with the Identity engineering teams to ensure that proposed solutions meet the expected outcome, and that we collectively deliver an identity experience that is both secure by default and simple for administrators to operate at scale.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, IdP integrations, RBAC/permissions, user provisioning) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide a trusted, frictionless experience to millions of developers and thousands of enterprise administrators.


What you will do

  • Contribute to the different areas of the Identity vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

  • Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on enterprise-grade authentication, authorization, and access management.

  • Interact directly with our users and customers to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

  • Develop a deep understanding of enterprise identity needs (e.g., SSO/SAML/OIDC, IdP integrations such as Okta and Entra ID, SCIM/user provisioning, and fine-grained permissions) and how we can enable organizations to onboard and administer users at scale.

  • Drive modernization of enterprise identity and access management, including expanding IdP support and hardening permissions and role management for the largest, most complex organizations.

  • Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product features.

  • Align with the engineering and UX teams on the problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

  • Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

  • Attend conferences and give talks if you like.

  • Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.


    • Experience and qualifications

  • Passionate about identity and access management, and the practices that lead to seamless and secure authentication systems.

  • Deep understanding of identity protocols and patterns (e.g., SAML, OIDC/OAuth2, SSO, SCIM/provisioning, JWT) and enterprise identity providers (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, or similar).

  • Technical comprehension of permissions and access control models (RBAC/ABAC) and multi-tenant SaaS access control.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

  • Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative

  • A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external

  • Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture

Strong-to-have:

  • An audit or accounting background, or deep knowledge of financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP)

  • Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

  • Experience in agentic products, workflows and systems

 

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Assessment interview

Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. Over time, you will lead initiatives across the company, in domains you may not know yet.

What you will do

  • Frame ambiguous strategic intents into clear problems, objectives and business cases, starting from the impact on our customers and the business.

  • Re-plan quickly when priorities or context change, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Bridge leadership and operational teams: engage stakeholders early, manage competing priorities and keep sponsors and teams aligned.

  • Stay agile and pragmatic: run initiatives with simple, effective tools and communication rather than heavy process and admin, pick the approach that drives the behaviors and actions needed, re-plan quickly when context changes, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them pragmatically: just enough process, simple tools and clear communication, never process for its own sake.

  • Own change management as part of delivery (communication, training, champions, reinforcement) until new ways of working stick, with particular care for the human side of AI-driven change.

Experience and qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 10+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, international transformation or strategic initiatives, ideally combining strategy or transformation consulting with in-house experience in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

  • Bring a proven track record of measurable outcomes (revenue, cost, efficiency, adoption, customer experience), not just projects delivered.

  • Have a strong customer mindset: see internal work as a way to serve customers, and use that lens to set priorities.

  • Use AI agents and assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) hands-on every day, with concrete examples of skills, agents or workflows they have built.

  • Have designed or delivered AI-enabled processes, with a pragmatic view of AI's value, limits and risks.

  • Be strongly data-driven: analyze business data themselves (spreadsheets, SQL or BI tools, AI-assisted analysis) to build business cases and track results.

  • Demonstrate strong change management, stakeholder management and communication skills, having led people through significant change and influenced executives and operational teams alike.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic Safety
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral AI provides full-stack AI solutions, from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute, used by developers, enterprises, and public institutions worldwide. We are a dynamic, creative, low-ego team distributed across Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East, passionate about AI's potential to transform society.

As our models and products reach millions of people and power increasingly critical workloads across enterprises and public institutions, safety is becoming an essential product challenge.

We are looking for our first Product Manager, Agentic Safety to own this space end-to-end, translating safety research and policy into concrete, user-facing product behaviors across our API platform and product surfaces.

You will define which guardrails should be enabled by default, what controls customers should have, and how we measure and communicate residual risk. Working at the intersection of Product, Research, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Security, you will shape how safety is built into our products, balancing protection, usability, and customer needs.

This is a unique opportunity to build a new product function from the ground up and directly influence how frontier AI is deployed responsibly at scale.

What You Will Do

Safety Product Strategy

  • Own the Safety roadmap across Mistral's API platform and products, including Vibe and Studio, from strategy through to product behavior and delivery.

  • Define the product vision and priorities for safety features, guardrails, controls, and safeguards.

  • Translate safety research and policy requirements into practical product capabilities that customers can understand, configure, and trust.

  • Determine which safety mechanisms should be enabled by default and where customers should have flexibility and control.

Safety Measurement and Evaluation

  • Define how safety is measured across our products, including evaluations, residual risk, precision and coverage trade-offs, and emerging harm trends.

  • Establish clear metrics and take accountability for tracking and improving safety performance.

  • Work closely with Research and Engineering teams to translate evaluation results into actionable product improvements.

  • Ensure safety considerations are embedded in feature launches and deployment decisions through a safety-by-design approach.

Incident Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Safety incident response and post-incident reviews.

  • Turn safety events, emerging risks, and customer feedback into concrete product improvements.

  • Establish processes to identify, assess, and mitigate safety risks across our products.

  • Continuously assess the effectiveness of existing safeguards and identify opportunities to strengthen them.

Cross-Functional Leadership and External Representation

  • Partner closely with Policy, Legal, Research, Engineering, Security, and Operations to drive safety initiatives across the organization.

  • Align and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver safety improvements without compromising product velocity or customer trust.

  • Represent Mistral on Safety product topics in discussions with customers and regulators.

  • Communicate complex safety decisions, trade-offs, and residual risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

  • Several years of experience in Product Management, with meaningful exposure to Safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, or AI safety.

  • Strong technical understanding of LLM guardrails, safety evaluations, and red-teaming, with the ability to discuss thresholds, methodologies, and trade-offs with researchers and engineers.

  • Strong product judgment when navigating ambiguous trade-offs between safety and freedom of expression, as well as safety and product utility.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions and articulate the rationale behind product choices.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, align stakeholders, and inspire teams without direct authority.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and building from zero, with the ability to define a new function rather than simply maintain an existing product line.

  • Experience working at an AI lab or frontier-model company is a plus.

  • Exposure to AI regulation and compliance frameworks, particularly the EU AI Act, is a plus.

  • An engineering or research background is a plus.

  • You don't necessarily check every box above but are genuinely driven by the mission of making frontier AI safe and trustworthy for the people and organizations who rely on it.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.
