jobs.title: Solution Architect - Power & Utilities
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As our Solutions Architect, you will act as the senior industry expert bridging the gap between our autonomous robotic technology and the Power & Utilities sector, and more broadly the maintenance, reliability and asset performance communities of asset-intensive industries. This is a highly visible, strategic role designed for a visionary who thrives on customer engagement, executive networking, and shaping product roadmaps – offering the thrill of a sales-focused environment without the pressure of a quota.

You are the counterpart, in the Product Management organization, to our Key Account Managers. While the Account Manager develops and maintains a high-touch relationship with the customer, identifies key decision-makers and devises the account penetration strategy, you deliver the solution required to fulfil the customer engagement: you aggregate and synthesize the current and future ANYbotics product stack (robot platform, operational design domain, inspection payloads, data insights, data lake integration, APM/CMMS systems integration) into cohesive technical solutions, complete with the business models and contractual frameworks tailored to our top-priority accounts. This role is central to our Go-To-Market strategy, centered on project sales and deeper, more focused engagements with key accounts.

You will define high-impact use cases, orchestrate business value engineering, and mentor our internal teams. If you are passionate about driving product vision and enjoy travelling to connect directly with industry leaders, this role offers unparalleled impact.


The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is a tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics through Embodied AI across multiple industries. Our autonomous quadruped robots, like ANYmal, are redefining safety and productivity in the world’s most demanding environments – from offshore oil rigs to chemical plants, power plants, substations, utilities and other complex industrial sectors. We provide an end-to-end solution that combines cutting-edge autonomy, high-value data analytics and mechanical engineering excellence, enabling the autonomous inspection and monitoring of large-scale facilities, increasing safety while maximizing uptime for the world’s most critical infrastructure.

This creates an interesting commercial environment. Our deals do not stop when a contract is signed: orders have downstream implications across Finance and Operations and ultimately lead to the delivery and deployment of physical technology, integrated with customer systems, at customer sites.


About Us

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection. Headquartered in Zurich and with a growing international presence, our team brings together expertise across robotics, software, hardware, product, operations and commercial functions. As our customer base and commercial organization scale, we are investing in the processes and capabilities needed to support that growth – this role is one of them.


Your Contributions
  • Architect vertical solutions. Design tailored solutions and define compelling use cases for the Power & Utilities industry, synthesising robotics, inspection payloads and data insights into solutions that integrate seamlessly into customer workflows and systems (APM, CMMS/EAM, historians, DCS/SCADA). Build the supporting business models and contractual frameworks needed to deliver turnkey value.
  • Quantify customer outcomes. Lead business value engineering: build robust business cases with quantitative ROI (avoided downtime, exposure hours, inspection cost, integrity risk) and qualitative benefits, and articulate clearly the tangible business benefits of our autonomous inspection solutions.
  • Partner with executives and the Commercial team. Work closely with prospect and customer executives to drive strategic alignment, lead customer discovery and value engineering workshops, and act as the consultative product partner to Key Account Managers on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Enable Go-to-Market excellence. Develop and deliver sales enablement toolkits – vertical positioning, use-case catalogues, competitive intelligence, reference architectures and training – so the Commercial team can articulate our value and win in your vertical.
  • Evangelize our technology. Represent ANYbotics within the partner ecosystem (APM/EAM software vendors, engineering and service partners), lead professional sessions at industry events, and engage with independent analysts (e.g. Gartner).
  • Shape the roadmap. Bring deep industry insights to product marketing and product management; identify emerging value drivers and work directly with Product Managers and R&D to embed your market vision in the technical roadmap.
  • Mentor. Share critical industry knowledge with the business value consulting team and coach younger engineers and account teams.

    • Your Profile
  • Experience:  At least 15 years of hands-on industry experience in Maintenance or Reliability Engineering, with a strong Asset Performance Management (APM) background, gained within Power & Utilities and/or other asset-heavy industries (Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Metals, high-volume Manufacturing). You have lived the reality of maintenance strategies, integrity programmes and reliability improvement inside operating plants.
  • Interdisciplinary Background:  A well-balanced background bridging software, APM and maintenance; this is not a pure hardware or automation engineering role. A strong understanding of how automated inspection, control and maintenance systems (mobile robotics, IoT, DCS/SCADA, CMMS, APM) fit into complex industrial workflows.
  • Customer and deal leadership:  Proven ability to lead complex customer discovery, navigate executive-level conversations and contribute heavily to major deals; a sharp observer of customer personas and pain points.
  • Financial and contractual fluency:  Comfortable building business cases, navigating pricing models and handling the business and contractual nuances of technical partnerships and strategic agreements.
  • Executive communication and influence:  Excellent written and oral communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into high-value narratives for audiences ranging from R&D engineers to C-suite executives, and to motivate internal stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Cross-functional collaboration:  Strong collaboration skills, particularly in partnering with product managers, product marketing and the Commercial organization.
  • Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or related).
  • Grit and mobility:  A self-starter who thrives in the fast-paced environment of a scaling deep-tech company, with high enthusiasm for significant travel (30–40%+) to engage directly with customers, prospects and industry networks.

    • Bonus Points
  • Previous experience as a Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Engineer, Product Manager, Business Value Consultant or Reliability Engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with leading APM/EAM platforms (e.g. GE Vernova APM, AVEVA, Bentley, IBM Maximo, SAP PM/IAM, Hexagon) and their integration patterns.
  • Certifications such as CMRP, CRE, API 510/570/580, or equivalent reliability and integrity credentials.
  • Experience deploying automated or robotic inspection programmes in industrial environments.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Dach (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our Munich office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in Germany and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

     

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level german speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Munich office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

 

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Munich office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer

 

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience.

Why This Role Stands Out

Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before.

You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year.

AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience.

We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones.

What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer?

  • Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key.

  • Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace.

  • Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards.

  • Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Ecommerce Journey: Design and build the features and systems powering Fleek's core marketplace, across frontend and backend, from item discovery and search through to checkout, payment, and post-purchase. These are product features that directly drive GMV.

  • Integrate AI into the Product: Build the features and services that connect FleekSort's AI classification engine to the marketplace experience, ensuring grading, pricing, and categorisation flow seamlessly into listings, search, and buyer workflows.

  • Design for Scale: Architect systems that handle 500K+ items per month today, with a clear path to millions. Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability.

  • Shape Technical Direction: Contribute to architectural decisions across the stack. Challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and help define engineering standards for a fast-growing team.

  • Mentor and Elevate: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work embedded with your product manager and designer to define what gets built. Partner with data, AI, and operations teams to turn complex real-world logistics into reliable, scalable software.

What You Bring

  • A track record of shipping product: You've built and owned user-facing features end to end, at a marketplace, fintech or consumer company; we care more about what you've shipped than how many years it took.

  • You start from the user: You talk to buyers and sellers, watch where they get stuck, and can explain why what you're building matters to the person using it.

  • You think like a PM: You shape the problem as well as the solution, push back when something doesn't feel right, and tie your work to GMV, conversion or retention.

  • You ship fast and learn: You'd rather put a working version in front of users this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you're used to deploying daily.

  • You measure what you build: You define success before you start and use data, user feedback and experiments to decide what to build next.

  • You build AI-native: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you've shipped features on LLMs or ML models, with evals to know they work.

  • You work across the stack: You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable enough on the frontend and in the data layer to ship a feature end to end, whichever way you lean.

  • You have sound judgement: You make sensible trade-offs between speed and scale, think about failure modes in systems that move real money, and know when good enough is good enough.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketplace dynamics: two-sided platforms, pricing, trust, supply-demand matching

  • Familiarity with international systems and distributed teams across multiple time zones

A genuine excitement for building something from scratch in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

This Role Isn't for You If You Want:

  • Narrow, siloed ownership where you only touch one service and never see the user

  • Detailed specs handed to you before you start, we define problems together

  • A slow-moving, highly structured environment with long release cycles

  • Fully remote work, this team is on-site in London 3-4 days per week

  • Pure infrastructure or platform work with no product exposure

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: On-site

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan

  • Stack: TypeScript and Node.js across frontend and backend, AI/ML integration

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

What's In It for You?

Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally.

Why people join Fleek

  • The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact.

  • The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper.

  • The growth is exceptional: Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

  • The timing is perfect: The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027. EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. You're catching a wave.

  • You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

jobs.title: Unit Lead (m/w/d) Digitale Produkte & Services
jobs.description:
Digital. Made Human.

SHAPE ist eine Digitalagentur mit Hauptsitz in Hamburg. Design, Technologie und Security kommen hier aus einer Hand: von der Produkt- und Serviceentwicklung über sichere Architekturen für regulierte Branchen bis zu Creative Technology. Seit 2012 hat SHAPE in der DACH-Region mehr als 750 digitale Projekte entlang der gesamten Customer Experience umgesetzt. Rund 140 Spezialist:innen arbeiten an sechs Standorten in Deutschland, der Schweiz und Kroatien. SHAPE ist nach ISO 27001 und ISO 9001 zertifiziert und Teil der internationalen MYTY Group.

Als Unit Lead verantwortest du die Projekte deiner Unit – von Scope und Budget bis zu Zeitplan und Qualität. Deine Unit kann dabei für einen oder mehrere Kundinnen arbeiten. Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für eure Kund*innen, planst die Kapazitäten im Team und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte wirtschaftlich und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Fach Leads zusammen. Sie verantworten fachliche Standards und die Entwicklung der Kolleg*innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Team und Projekte im Alltag rund laufen.

Wo du arbeitest

Optimal wäre es, wenn du in Berlin, Hamburg, Braunschweig, Husum oder Umgebung lebst. So können wir uns bei Workshops, Kundenterminen oder im Büro auch persönlich begegnen. Dein Wohnort ist dafür aber keine Voraussetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst deine Unit im Projektalltag und bist für die Menschen darin erste Ansprechperson in Planungsfragen, vom Projekteinsatz bis zum Urlaub.

  • Du planst die Kapazitäten deiner Unit und besetzt Projekte gemeinsam mit den Fach Leads so, dass Fachlichkeit und Team-Stabilität zusammenpassen.

  • Du verantwortest Scope, Budget und Zeit deiner Projekte und die Qualität des Ergebnisses.

  • Du steuerst Anforderungen, Risiken und Scope, übernimmst dabei Product-Owner-Verantwortung und triffst Produktentscheidungen gemeinsam mit Team und Kund*innen.

  • Du erkennst Hindernisse früh und räumst sie aus dem Weg, damit dein Team konzentriert arbeiten kann.

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für die Kund*innen deiner Unit, pflegst langfristige Beziehungen und präsentierst Ergebnisse auch vor Entscheider*innen.

  • Du gibst deinem Team regelmäßig operatives Feedback und bringst deine Sicht in die Entwicklungsgespräche ein.

  • Gemeinsam mit unserem COO verantwortest du die Wirtschaftlichkeit deiner Unit, von Angebot und Budgetplanung bis zu Controlling und Abrechnung.

  • Du sprichst Konflikte früh an und verhandelst Scope, Budget und Termine so, dass die Lösung für beide Seiten passt..

  • Du machst Projekterfolge sichtbar, zum Beispiel in Case Studies, Business-Präsentationen oder in internen Formaten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools, um Abläufe in deiner Unit effizienter zu machen, und gestaltest gemeinsam mit den anderen Unit Leads mit, wie SHAPE arbeitet.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement digitaler Produkte oder Softwareprojekte, idealerweise 5 Jahre und mehr, gern in einer Digitalagentur.

  • Erfahrung darin, cross-funktionale Teams im Projektalltag zu führen, etwa als Senior PM, Delivery Lead oder Teamlead.

  • Ein Talent für Organisation: Du planst sauber, behältst viele Themen gleichzeitig im Blick und merkst früh, wann ein Plan angepasst werden muss.

  • Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer Rolle, in der du Anforderungen priorisiert und Produktentscheidungen getroffen hast.

  • Klare Kommunikation, mit deinem Team genauso wie mit Entscheider*innen auf Kundenseite.

  • Betriebswirtschaftliches Denken und Erfahrung mit Projektkalkulation, Budgets und Controlling.

  • Ein Gespür für Kund*innen und ihre Ziele, auch wenn diese noch nicht ganz klar formuliert sind.

  • Sicherheit in Verhandlungen und die Ruhe, schwierige Gespräche konstruktiv zu führen.

  • Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise. Du bleibst gelassen, wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig Aufmerksamkeit brauchen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kund*innen, dazu gutes Englisch.

Was nicht perfekt sein muss

Du musst kein Scrum-Coach sein und keinen Code schreiben. Für Methoden, Standards und Architektur gibt es bei uns Fach Leads. Technisches Verständnis wächst im Alltag, mit erfahrenen Entwickler*innen und Designer*innen an deiner Seite. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Teams führen und Projekte zusammenhalten kannst.

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit klarer Verantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Fach Leads an deiner Seite.

  • Regelmäßiger Austausch mit den anderen Unit Leads, zum Beispiel bei gemeinsamen Offsites.

  • Remote Work und flexible Arbeitszeiten, dazu Ausstattung fürs Homeoffice.

  • Projekte für namhafte Kund*innen, die du über längere Zeit begleitest und mitgestaltest.

  • Weiterbildung und Mentoring, auch für deine Entwicklung als Führungskraft.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sportmitgliedschaft sowie Gutscheine und Rabatte.

  • Ein Team, das offen diskutiert, Konventionen hinterfragt und Entscheidungen gemeinsam in Workshops und Sprints trifft.

  • Haustiere sind im Büro willkommen.


Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Erzähl uns lieber in ein paar Sätzen, wie du führst und warum du Lust auf SHAPE hast.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung.

You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.

  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why the Cohere TPM role?

As our Generative Machine Learning organization has continued growing, we are looking for more Technical Program Managers to join the team!

At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts. Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work. Cohere’s TPMs would often be described as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic leaders who are adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead.

As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented AI researchers and industry experts in the world on building cutting edge AI technology. No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company!

Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are highly prioritizing hiring for people who are within 1-2 hours of British Standard Time (BST).

As a Machine Learning Technical Program Manager, you will:

  • Establish, improve, and scale foundational processes that allow the Generative Modeling teams to execute better, faster, and more predictably

  • Scale the operational capacity and effectiveness of the Modeling TPM team in collaboration with the Modeling TPM lead to ensure the function can remain lean and effective during a period of the program portfolio complexity and size continuing to rapidly increase

  • Flexibly adapt to the needs of the company, programs, and the team from tackling long-horizon programs that can span quarters or even years to jumping onto often highly ambiguous short-term challenges that can have company-wide impact

  • Partner directly with leaders within and outside of the Modeling organization on efforts to design, train and improve our core generative models

  • Lead cross-functional, oftentimes company-wide programs and strategic initiatives, collaborating and coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Legal, Platform, Infra, Policy, and Finance

  • Operate as an organizational expert in improving engineering execution rigor and operations on the ground, while contributing to the strategic layer in areas such as long-term strategic planning with senior modeling leadership

  • Map out dependencies and risks, and ensure that cross-functional execution across the program runs smoothly, communicating status with non-technical and technical stakeholders and senior management

  • Both own and enable a useful communication flow of priorities, ideas, and knowledge throughout and beyond the Modeling organization in line with your programs

  • Respond quickly to program-level changes, clarifying new scope, and managing resource needs in response to evolving priorities

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5-10 years as a Technical Program Manager AND 5+ years of experience working directly on AI/ML. Strong preference for candidates that have worked directly in building foundation models.

  • In-depth knowledge of machine learning, particularly when it comes to Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models (LLMs). Bonus points for experience with Multimodal AI.

  • Experience with working in a chaotic, fast paced, low structure environment. We need someone who is pragmatic, can roll up their sleeves when needed, and can function at the tactical and strategic level to do whatever it takes to make Cohere’s models succeed

  • Personal hands-on understanding of the unique challenges of managing projects and programs in the AI/ML development space as opposed to traditional software program management

  • Managed projects & programs requiring a strong general business acumen, such as coordinating with Finance on reporting needs or Policy on regulatory compliance matters — the broader your experience beyond ML technical program management, the better!

  • (optional, but preferred) Have technical experience in a hands-on capacity. We don’t necessarily need someone with hands on experience training models, but you need to feel comfortable sitting in the same rooms with some of the best researchers in the world, working on highly complex, cutting edge ML problems

If some of the above - other than the ML TPM experience - doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you.

We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

 

Your expedition: Product & Growth

 

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.

 

While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

  • Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

  • Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

  • Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

  • Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role

✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.

✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth

✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)

✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back

✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo

✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire.

You communicate constructively, if necessary directly with stakeholders, and help turn complex business needs into sustainable technical solutions.

  • Design, develop, and deploy robust and scalable services using Python with FastAPI or Django

  • Conceptualize and improve our software architecture

  • Understand and solve complex business requirements

  • Take ownership of services and technical decisions, and actively contribute to agile ceremonies

  • Share your expertise, support knowledge sharing, and improve engineering practices

  • Write RFCs for the decisions and maintain Architecture Decisions Records

Our Tech Stack

  • Python, FastAPI, Django
  • Celery
  • MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
  • GitLab, CI/CD
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • React, TypeScript
  • Google Cloud
  • TDD, DDD, Playwright
  • AI-assisted development and AI workflows

Your profile

  • Several years of professional experience with Python and FastAPI or Django
  • Proven experience with distributed systems and cloud technologies, preferably GCP
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to deliver software efficiently while maintaining high-quality standards
  • Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments
  • Passion for testing, clean architecture, and clean code
  • Fluent in English and great communication skills for discussions and code reviews
  • Please note: We can only accept applications with a valid work permit

You can look forward to

  • Flexible working hours: We follow a hybrid work model with 20 in-office days per quarter to foster important personal interaction while enabling a modern, flexible way of working. The remaining days can be worked from home, and you also have the option to spend up to 6 weeks per year working from countries within EU. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours to fit your individual needs.
  • Individual work environment: Design your ergonomic workspace just the way you like it – with height-adjustable desks and the laptop of your choice (MacBook or ThinkPad). If things get a bit noisy in the office, your Bose noise-cancelling headphones ensure uninterrupted focus. If needed, we can also provide you with an ergonomic chair or additional monitors for your home office.
  • Open work environment: We work together in a bright, open-plan office where even the few existing doors are always open. Our teams are motivated and open to new ideas. Bring your creativity to the table and make things happen! If you need a moment of peace, you can retreat to a cosy corner of the medimops library in the break room, or recharge with a game of foosball, table tennis, or PlayStation.
  • Sustainability: We love second-hand and incorporate our sustainable business idea into the office routine with simple methods like using eco-friendly supplies, double-sided printing, energy-saving modes on devices, waste separation, etc. In doing so, we take responsibility and integrate sustainability into all our activities.
  • Training: momox is only as good as you. That's why you will find room and budget for your individual professional development with language classes, internal training, conferences, (online) courses and more.
  • Sport and fitness offers: During the week, you have the opportunity to take part in various sports activities. Whether it's online training, massages, or stretching at your desk – there's something for everyone. You can also get a discounted membership for Urban Sports Club or Wellhub.
  • Office dogs: Our office dogs contribute to a relaxed work atmosphere and are always happy to receive some extra cuddles.
  • Team events: Having fun at work and celebrating our successes together are core to our values. That’s why we regularly come together at various events to connect, get to know each other better, and strengthen our team spirit.

jobs.title: Group Master Data Manager Customers
jobs.description:
We want you to grow with us:

We are strengthening our Information Management function. As our next Group Master Data Manager Customers, you will lead the customer agenda within Group Master Data, continuously developing our Customer Master Data governance and processes to ensure high-quality, consistent and compliant customer data across all countries.

You will join the Information Management team, reporting to the Master Data Manager and working closely with process owners, solution owners, transformation teams, colleagues and internal IT across the organisation. You will take ownership of global standards, drive continuous improvement and shape the development of the Customer Master Data community across the Intersnack Group through a train-the-trainer approach.

What we can offer:

This position places you at the centre of how Intersnack manages its customer data worldwide. You will own the Group's Customer Master Data standards, policies and governance, continuously adapt global processes across our Management Units and partner directly with business stakeholders and internal IT to turn high-quality data into measurable business value.

This role has group-wide scope and visibility, with regular travel from Düsseldorf to our Management Units (up to 20% annually). You will be part of an international, collaborative environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation and continuous improvement, with professional development opportunities to deepen your expertise in master data management, governance and data-driven business transformation.

How you will spend your time as our next Group Master Data Manager Customers:

You will combine ownership of Customer Master Data with hands-on governance and continuous improvement, working closely with business stakeholders, Process Owners and internal IT to ensure our customer data is accurate, consistent and aligned with business processes across the group.

What you will do

  • Own and further shape the Group's Customer Master Data standards, policies, governance and controls

  • Continuously adapt the defined global processes, ensuring consistency across countries while accommodating justified local requirements

  • Drive customer data quality, monitor performance and resolve underlying issues to improve accuracy, consistency and compliance

  • Act as the Group's Customer Master Data expert, working with business stakeholders, Process Owners and internal IT to meet business needs

  • Oversee customer master data solutions, configuration and integrations, ensuring alignment with global standards and business processes

  • Manage functional requirements, testing and approval of system changes and releases, ensuring effective implementation

  • Lead the Group Customer Master Data community across the Intersnack Group, sharing best practices and supporting local teams through a train-the-trainer approach

  • Identify and deliver improvements to data governance, processes and systems, taking ownership of decisions and outcomes

What we expect of you:

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in one or more of the following areas: Master Data Management (MDM), ERP or CRM, with a focus on customer master data in an internationally operating industrial company

  • Strong understanding of customer business processes, governance and data management

  • Experience in roll-out and training concepts, applying a structured project management approach

  • Proactive, solution-focused working style with a positive can-do attitude and the ability to deliver quality results on time

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative working style

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the capacity for mature judgment in challenging situations

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus

  • Willingness to travel to Intersnack locations as required (up to 20% annually)

Valuable Experience

  • Experience within FMCG, manufacturing or the food industry

  • Prior experience with train-the-trainer approaches in cross-border master data rollouts

 

Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position.

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG. 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large or very large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

jobs.description:
Why Coda
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including  Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Opportunity
As Senior Financial Analyst at Coda, you'll play a key role in shaping how we plan, forecast, and steer our financial performance. You'll coordinate our budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning cycles, bringing together our B2B and B2C businesses into one clear financial outlook. You'll also take ownership of our planning and reporting processes in Aleph and manage the group's non-personnel fixed operating expenses.

Reporting to the Director of FP&A, this is a hands-on role with high visibility and real impact. Your work will directly inform decisions made by our CFO, executive team, and Board, giving you the opportunity to influence how Coda plans for the future.


What You'll Do
  • Planning: Own the annual budget, regular forecasts and long-term financial planning process across the Group.
  • Consolidation: Integrate B2B and B2C forecasts into a comprehensive Group P&L, balance sheet and cash flow outlook.
  • Quality: Own key financial assumptions, challenge business drivers and ensure consistency, accuracy and reliability across forecasts.
  • Strategic Insights: Develop financial scenarios, sensitivity analyses and product profitability insights to support executive decision-making.
  • Ownership: Lead the development of our financial planning platform, streamlining forecasting, consolidations and reporting into one efficient process.
  • Automation and AI: Identify and implement smarter ways of working to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability across FP&A.
  • Budgeting: Own the budget for non-personnel operating expenses, set cost centre targets and oversee approvals for unbudgeted spending.
  • Reporting: Prepare and review high-quality financial analyses, Board materials, investor updates and lender reporting, including covenant calculations.
  • Partner: Work closely with the Director FP&A and step in to lead planning and reporting cycles when required.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Accounting, Treasury and Business Control teams across Amsterdam, Singapore and Jakarta to drive alignment and financial performance.

    • What You'll Bring
  • FP&A expertise: 6-8 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance or a related field, including at least 3 years leading budgeting and forecasting cycles.
  • Planning & consolidation: Proven experience managing and consolidating forecasts across multiple entities, markets or business units.
  • Financial modelling: Strong three-statement modelling skills and a solid understanding of cash flow and working capital.
  • Systems & analytical skills: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency and hands-on experience with planning tools such as Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment or similar.
  • Stakeholder management: Confidence to collaborate with, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business.
  • Communication & education: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a degree in finance, economics, econometrics or a related field.
  • Business environment: Experience in a high-growth, international or investor-backed organisation is a strong advantage.
  • Strategic finance exposure: Familiarity with Board, investor or lender reporting, including financial covenants. A background in Big 4, transaction services or investment banking is a plus.
  • Process improvement & innovation: A track record of building scalable finance processes, implementing or improving planning systems, or leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency is highly valued.
  • Mindset & ownership: Structured, pragmatic and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, the ability to deliver under pressure and confidence working across international teams and time zones.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description:

 

We want to make the best decisions possible for our products and to do that, we need to make data-driven decisions.

To achieve this goal, we are looking for a talented Data Engineer - you! - to join the Data & ML Platform team.

Together, we will make Sonar’s products the undisputed world-leading code remediation solution!

 

What you will do

You will design and develop the data platform to support the functional domains in handling their data and help them in their journey to data ownership. This means:

  • Design and implement data storage, transformation, and load capabilities of our pipelines.
  • Continuously enhance the data platform. Propose, implement and manage data handling services according to  stakeholders needs (Product Managers, Marketing, Sales, engineering teams, ...)
  • Establish top-class end-to-end pipelines including data cleaning and modelling.
  • Develop and deploy connectors to data sources of interest.
  • Maintain evergreen data flow documentation across systems.
  • Collaborate on Data Governance with other stakeholders/domains.
  • Work with the security function to ensure we adhere to expected security standards.
  • Collaborate with the incident manager to bring your expertise when asked and own implementation of recommendations from post-mortems.

    • Experience and qualifications

  • You have solid software engineering experience, focusing on developing data engineering pipelines and storage in the cloud. You have been exposed to big data architecture essentials, streaming, ETL batches, data store administration, …
