At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Machine Learning & AI at Trainline 👋

Machine learning and AI are at the core of how Trainline is transforming travel, helping millions of customers make smarter, more sustainable journeys every day. Our ML models and AI solutions power critical aspects of our platform, including:

  • Advanced search and recommendations capabilities across our mobile and web applications

  • Pricing and routing optimisations to find the best fares for customers

  • Personalised user experiences enhanced by agentic AI

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production. We work closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline.

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join our team help shape the future of train travel. You’ll be joining a high-performing, deeply technical community of Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to tackle complex problems by combining Trainline’s rich datasets with cutting edge algorithms. What unites our team is an expertise in the field, a love of what we do and the desire to create impactful solutions to support Trainline’s goals of encouraging sustainable travel.

As a part of Trainline you will be joining an environment where learning and development is top priority. You will have the opportunity to work with fellow ML & AI enthusiasts on large-scale production systems, delivering highly impactful products that make a difference to our millions of customers.

  • Work in cross-functional teams combining data scientists, software, data and machine learning engineers, and product managers

  • Design and deliver machine learning models and/or AI solutions at scale that drive measurable impact for Trainline

  • Own the full end-to-end machine learning delivery lifecycle including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, offline and online evaluation, deployments and maintenance

  • Partner with stakeholders to propose innovative data products that leverage Trainline’s extensive datasets and state of the art algorithms

  • Create the tools, frameworks and libraries that enables the acceleration of our ML & AI products delivery and improve our workflows

  • Take an active part in our AI and ML community and foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation

We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍

  • Have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a similar quantitative discipline

  • Are proficient with Python, including open-source data libraries (e.g Pandas, Numpy, Scikit learn etc.)

  • Have experience with agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD processes and tools

  • Have a broad of understanding of data extraction, data manipulation and feature engineering techniques

  • Are familiar with statistical methodologies

Nice to have:

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: Business Partner - DACH
jobs.description:
About Continuity

At Continuity, we’re building AI-native solutions that are redefining how insurers assess, monitor, and act on risk in the €1T+ commercial insurance industry.

In today’s world, insurers are expected to make complex, high-stakes decisions, often with outdated tools and fragmented data. We're rewriting that reality. Our platform combines specialized AI, structured data, and underwriting expertise to empower insurers with the clarity, speed, and confidence they need to take smarter risks, faster.

As the trusted partner of leading commercial P&C insurers, Continuity enables underwriting teams to:

  • Instantly detect and qualify risks

  • Keep portfolios up to date in real-time

  • Automate and accelerate decision-making from quote to bind

Our SaaS platform turns complex and scattered data into a clear, actionable interface, allowing underwriters to focus on what matters most: client relationships, portfolio profitability, and precision at scale.

Backed by a €10M Series A round in 2024, we are now scaling internationally and doubling down on innovation. With more than 50% of our team dedicated to R&D, we’re exploring the frontiers of AI in insurance, from intelligent agents to adaptive underwriting workflows, to fundamentally transform how insurance operates.

Joining Continuity means joining a high-impact, fast-growing team where your work shapes the future of risk intelligence. We’re not just building better tools, we’re helping the industry operate with a new level of intelligence.

What do we promote?

Our strong commitments include to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. Our cultural drivers {empathy, impact, innovation, and collaboration} guide us as we work together to create meaningful change. This is why we focus on the skills and potential you bring, rather than just your academic background or past experiences.

We believe that talent is shaped by diverse life journeys, and we’re excited to see how yours can contribute to our team while uncovering new perspectives and opportunities for growth together!

Role overview:

Germany is not a test. It's a commitment.

Our pipeline is live. Our first clients are onboard. The commercial momentum is real and we are now looking for the person who will turn that momentum into lasting, measurable client success.

This is not a support role. This is a builder position. You will work in close partnership with our Head of BD DACH, owning everything that happens from the first client handshake through to long-term value delivery. You will be the operational backbone of our DACH expansion, the person who makes sure that what we promise, we deliver.

If you thrive at the intersection of client trust, structured execution, and commercial impact, this role was designed for you.

Location: Germany or France (flexible) Regular travel required across Europe and France

Start by listening, then make it happen

One of our core beliefs at Continuity is that the best outcomes start with the deepest understanding. In this role, that means genuinely listening to what our clients need, not just what they say, and translating it into action that creates real value.

You will engage directly with senior decision-makers at leading insurers: CUOs, COOs, Heads of Underwriting. You will run workshops, challenge assumptions, and earn the kind of trust that turns a first contract into a long-term partnership. Your ability to hold the narrative in front of a room, and to listen carefully before you do, will define your impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Client Delivery & Deployment: Own the full client journey from needs assessment to operational go-live. You lead setup, coordinate with underwriters, facilitate workshops, and manage the client-facing narrative at every stage, with the rigour of a consultant and the energy of a builder.

  • POV Process Management: Drive Proof of Value processes for prospects not yet signed. You structure the deliverables, challenge the risk alerts, and make sure every POV builds a compelling, data-backed business case.

  • Paris / DACH Communication Bridge: You are the connective tissue between our German clients and our Paris delivery and product teams. Information flows clearly and nothing falls through the cracks - because you made sure of it.

  • Legal & Admin Coordination: Handle the contractual volume that comes with opening a new market - NDAs, DPAs, GDPR - with rigor and efficiency.

  • Commercial Expansion: Work alongside the Head of BD DACH to identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Every successful deployment is a potential success story, and you know how to build one.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Collaborate with our technical team on platform configuration and bring client insights back into the product roadmap. You are the voice of the DACH market internally.

  • Value Analysis: Turn platform data into high-impact business recommendations that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and make clients want to expand.

Make a measurable impact, from day one

We don't hire for potential and then put people in a corner. We hire people who are wired to execute, to deliver, and to raise the bar.

At 3 months, you will have full platform fluency, ownership of existing DACH accounts, and be fully embedded in our Paris workflows. At 6–9 months, you will be running deployments autonomously, driving a structured POV process, and identifying the first expansion opportunities in your accounts.

We care about results. We also care about how you get there, with rigour, ownership, and the kind of positive energy that makes hard things look manageable.

What you bring:

  • 3 to 7 years of experience from a high-performance environment: Strategy, Ops, M&A, Consulting, or equivalent. We care about the standard you've held yourself to, not the logo on your CV.

  • Strong quantitative skills: Excel and data analytics proficiency are non-negotiable. A data-crunch case study is part of our selection process - come prepared.

  • Native or near-native German and fluent English are essential. French is a bonus.

  • A Trusted Advisor posture: equally comfortable running a client workshop, analysing a dataset, and challenging a C-level assumption in the same afternoon.

  • Startup appetite: you don't need a playbook to get started. You write your own.

  • Output orientation: you take ownership, move fast, and close the loop, every time.

  • Insurance experience is a bonus but not required. A structured 3-month onboarding will get you fluent in our industry, our platform, and our clients.

We are one team, even across borders

At Continuity, "We Are One Team" is not a value we put on a slide and forget. It is the operating principle that makes everything else possible.

In this role, you will be the living proof of that principle across two geographies. You will bridge cultures, languages, and working styles, between Paris and Frankfurt/Munich, between product and client, between what was promised and what gets delivered. The ability to connect people, share context, and keep everyone moving in the same direction is not a soft skill here. It is a core competency.

You will not be alone. You will have the full support of our Head of BD DACH, our Paris delivery teams, and our leadership, all of whom are invested in making the DACH market work.

Build the future, with us

Germany is the beginning of something larger. As the DACH market scales, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your impact within the Revenue organisation.

We are not looking for someone to hold the fort. We are looking for someone who sees what this market could become and has the drive, the rigour, and the entrepreneurial instinct to help us get there.

Interview process

  • Introduction video call with (45')

  • Meet your future leader (60')

  • Prepare & present a Business Case ; meet cross team members (150')

  • Meet cross team members & executive leaders (90')

What we offer

  • Flexibility: With our Work Where You Like policy, you may be eligible to work from anywhere within France and soon from Europe!

  • Work life balance: We're here to support you in finding balance, no matter your personal circumstances.

  • Learning & Development: We’re committed to providing you with the resources, opportunities, and support you need to develop your skills and achieve your full potential.

  • Career growth: We provide clear development paths, skill-building opportunities, and support for internal mobility through open conversations & career coaching.

  • Health & Wellness: We offer comprehensive health insurance (maximum coverage with Alan Blue), dedicated relaxing events & resources like Moka.Care to support your physical, mental, and emotional health.

  • Life @Continuity: We create moments to come together, celebrate achievements, and strengthen our collective spirit.

  • Transportation & hotel costs: We provide partial reimbursement for public transport season tickets for office and hybrid employees, and cover transportation and accommodation costs for fully remote team members when needed.

  • Meals: We provide a restaurant card (Swile : 12€ per working day).

  • Home office setup: We provide all the necessary equipment to ensure you have the best setup for remote work.

  • Time-off: 25 days of holidays + RTT days.

  • Inclusion: All roles are open to candidates with disabilities. We adapt work conditions and the recruitment process as needed to ensure equal opportunities, just let us know how we can support you!

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. jobs.description:
Du hast dein Studium der Elektrotechnik gerade abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor? Dich reizt die Schnittstelle zwischen Automation, Netzwerken und IT? Dann bist du bei EXCO genau richtig! Als Automation / System Engineer IT/OT steigst du direkt in spannende Projekte ein und kannst dein Wissen von Anfang an praktisch einsetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest in Erweiterungs- und Modernisierungsprojekten mit – von der Spezifikation über die Netzwerkanbindung bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

  • Du hilfst mit, technische IT/OT-Anforderungen und Architekturen zu definieren.

  • Du suchst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Fehler auf System-, Applikations- und Netzwerkebene und behebst sie.

  • Du betreust Server-, Netzwerk- und OT-Infrastrukturen, die moderne Produktionsanlagen am Laufen halten.

  • Du unterstützt bei Wartungsaktivitäten (Patch-Management, Updates) und führst diese in Bezug auf alle lokalen IT/OT-Systeme durch.

  • Du übernimmst Aufgaben im Monitoring, Incident Management und Lebenszyklusmanagement der Server-Infrastruktur (inkl. User Management / Active Directory, Backup Management und Audit Trail Reviews).

  • Du erstellst technische Dokumentationen im regulierten Umfeld (GxP).

  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Digitalen Strategien und Konzepten.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes oder kurz vor dem Abschluss stehendes Studium (BSc/MSc) in Elektrotechnik, vorzugsweise mit dem Schwerpunkt Automation und Robotik

  • Begeisterung für die Schnittstelle von Automation, OT und IT

  • Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, LAN, VLAN) sowie in Windows und Linux – ob aus Studium, Projekten, Praktikum oder dem eigenen Homelab

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit SPS, Industrienetzwerken oder Virtualisierung sind von Vorteil

  • Analytisches Denken, Hartnäckigkeit bei der Fehlersuche und Lust, Bestehendes zu hinterfragen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Unsere Benefits

Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit im Rahmen der Gleitzeit flexibel einteilen.

Hybrides Arbeiten: Wir bieten dir einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz und geben dir zusätzlich die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten mit rund 20% Homeoffice.

Work-Life-Balance: Familienfreundliche Unternehmenskultur und Massnahmen zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

Einstieg mit Onboarding-Programm: Du wirst von einem Paten begleitet und erhältst eine fundierte Einarbeitung. Erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen stehen dir zur Seite, damit du dich schnell bei uns wohlfühlst und zurechtfindest.

Individuelles Coaching: Stillstand ist Rückschritt. Deshalb fördern wir deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch gezieltes Coaching und Weiterbildungen, die auf deine Interessen und Entwicklungsziele abgestimmt sind.

Firmenevents: In regelmässigen Abständen veranstalten wir Freizeitevents, bei denen Spass und die Freude am Miteinander im Vordergrund stehen.

Teamspirit erleben: Dich erwartet ein dynamisches Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen und kannst dein Wissen direkt in spannende Projekte einbringen.

Warum du bei EXCO starten solltest

EXCO Consulting GmbH in Root begleitet Pharma- und Medtech-Hersteller, LifeSciences-Unternehmen und Spitäler in der Schweiz. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Qualifizierung, Validierung, sowie Automation und Systemintegration – von SPS-, HMIund SCADA-Engineering über MES-Anbindungen bis zu Industrial IoT und OPC UA. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und profitieren gleichzeitig von über 20 Jahren Erfahrung und dem internationalen Netzwerk der EXCO Gruppe. Bei uns übernimmst du als Berufseinsteiger früh Verantwortung und hast erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen an deiner Seite, die dich unterstützen und fachlich weiterbringen.

Weitere Informationen über EXCO als Arbeitgeber und deinen Einstiegs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

jobs.title: Leitung Content & Personal Branding (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

  • Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team.

  • Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen.

  • Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil.

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content.

  • Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge.

  • Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf.

Was wir bieten

  • 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt.

  • Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events.

  • Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen.

  • Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events.

So bewirbst du dich

Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil.

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.


What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.description:
Most CFOs inherit a finance function.

This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where we stand

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.

We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.

That is the opening.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything financial:

  • Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
  • Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
  • The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
  • A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.

There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

The first year

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.

You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.

You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter.

Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action

The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!

jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here.

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Want to work at the frontier of AI and shape the most forward-looking event formats globally?

Events are where TabPFN meets the world, and one of our strongest channels. We show up at the most talked-about conferences across research and industry, in cities like New York, Seoul, Paris and Sydney, with one ambition: to be the name everyone remembers on the way home. And we create our own moments, from meetups and hackathons to executive dinners people want to be in the room for, where we lead the conversation on AI for tabular data.

You will be at the heart of how our events come together globally. You work hands-on with our Founders office, who owns the events strategy, and alongside sales, research and DevRel. You make sure every detail is taken care of, so every event is flawless on the day and turns into real conversations afterwards.

What you'll do across all of them

  • Support the team on site and make every guest experience seamless

  • Help build playbooks and automations, and track what each event delivered

  • Bring the vibe: dream up experiences people talk about, from activations and live demos to gamification, installations or the right DJ. If it makes the night, it's on the table

  • Capture content on site that brings every event to life on our social channels

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're organised, calm under pressure and obsessed with the details guests notice. You bring a strong executor mindset and know how to build experiences for high-profile guests, from executives and researchers to media and senior partners, with the judgment to make every event feel seamless, elevated and deeply considered.   • Hands-on experience with event logistics: venues, vendors, travel, guests

  • Experience with executive dinners, conference booths or side events

  • Great intuition and taste for what looks and feels good, you create experiences people remember and make everyone who didn't show up feel they missed out!

  • A bias for action and experimentation: you'd rather test and learn than wait for a perfect playbook

  • A strong collaborator: you coordinate smoothly with sales, research and DevRel

  • An AI-first way of working: you use the latest tools to run events leaner and faster

LOCATION

Life at Prior Labs

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. jobs.description:
Hier schreibst du nicht nur Java. Hier prägst du, wie das ganze Entwicklungsteam künftig mithilfe von KI Software baut.

Für ein international führendes Publishing-Tech-Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Java-Entwickler, der KI-gestützte Entwicklung zum Standard macht. Das Ziel ist Spec Driven Agentic Software Entwicklung bzw. ein echter AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle). Weitere Themen sind Compliance, Datensicherheit & Co. (ISO 27001 zertifiziert).

Das Unternehmen ...

... hinter dieser Stelle bringt seit über 15 Jahren Bücher in die digitale Welt. Auf einer selbst entwickelten Cloud-Plattform verwalten mehrere tausend Verlage ihre E-Books, Hörbücher und Podcasts und bringen sie von dort in alle relevanten Shops, Streaming- und Abo-Dienste weltweit.

Die Company ist in den letzten Jahren stark gewachsen, wird von einem der großen internationalen Software-Investoren unterstützt und beschäftigt ca. 230 Menschen an Standorten in Europa sowie Nord- und Südamerika. Das Herz der Software-Entwicklung schlägt in Dortmund.

KI ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Geschäftsfeld: Von KI-vertonten Hörbüchern über die Lizenzierung von Verlagsinhalten an KI-Unternehmen bis zur besseren Auffindbarkeit von Inhalten. Derzeit werden auch neue KI-basierte Funktionen und -Services für die Nutzer der Plattform entwickelt.


Der aktuelle Tech-Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL, TypeScript/React, Python, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Linux, Claude Code, Open Code.

Deine Mission

Das Entwicklungs-Team arbeitet bereits mit AI Coding Agents. Jetzt geht es darum, KI-gestütztes Entwickeln tief in den Prozess zu verankern. Du entwickelst die bestehenden Java-Produkte weiter, baust Neues - und zwar so, dass KI-Agenten einen großen Teil des Codes schreiben, während du Architektur, Qualität und Richtung verantwortest. Dabei nimmst du dein Team mit - mit funktionierenden Workflows, klaren Standards und ansteckender Begeisterung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst im Produktteam die Java-Plattform weiter und baust neue Lösungen für die internationale Publishing-Branche.

  • Du sprichst direkt mit Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern, verstehst Anforderungen aus erster Hand und übersetzt sie in präzise Vorgaben für Mensch und Maschine.

  • Du gestaltest Software-Architektur, Systemdesign und Schnittstellen maßgeblich mit.

Dein Profil

  • Freude am direkten Austausch mit Fachbereichen/Stakeholdern und Interesse daran, fachliche Zusammenhänge selbst zu verstehen, statt nur Spezifikationen umzusetzen. Fähigkeit, Anforderungen kritisch zu hinterfragen und eigenständig fachlich fundierte Entscheidungen bei der Umsetzung zu treffen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort & Schrift (C1) und gutes Englisch

Was dich erwartet

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events

  • Weitere Corporate Benefits

jobs.description:
About this role

We are looking for a Staff Cyber Security Specialist (f/m/x) to strengthen our Incident Response and Security Operations capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced incident responder who enjoys solving complex security challenges and helping organizations navigate critical cyber incidents.

In this role, you will lead incident response engagements from investigation through recovery, working directly with customers during some of their most challenging moments. You will act as a trusted technical authority within the team, mentor less experienced responders, and help drive improvements across our security operations.


Unlike traditional consultancy environments, you will operate within a product-driven MDR organization serving more than 1,000 customers across Europe. This gives you the opportunity to work at scale, leverage large security datasets, and contribute improvements that strengthen protections across our entire customer base.


You will work with state-of-the-art security tooling while collaborating with security professionals from intelligence, military, consulting, national CERT, and technology backgrounds.

Alongside operational response work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to internal research initiatives, Bug Bounty Fridays, Capture The Flag events, and other technical projects that help push our capabilities forward.

This position reports directly to the Director of Security Operations.

What you will do

  • Act as a leading technical authority within Security Operations, taking ownership of strategic improvement initiatives and helping shape the future direction of our incident response and security operations capabilities.

  • Lead cyber incident response engagements from intake through recovery.

  • Act as the technical lead during investigations, coordinating response activities and driving outcomes.

  • Conduct forensic investigations to determine attack scope, root cause, and impact.

  • Support customers during active cybersecurity incidents and provide clear technical guidance.

  • Support MDR and Security Operations activities when not engaged in active incident response cases.

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders, including management, legal counsel, law enforcement, and regulators when required.

  • Mentor junior and medior responders and help raise the technical maturity of the team.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of incident response methodologies, playbooks, and operational processes.

What you will need

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Security Operations, or related disciplines.

  • Proven ability to independently lead and manage cybersecurity incidents end-to-end.

  • In-depth knowledge of Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems, file systems, security architecture, and attack surfaces.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, networking, and network security principles.

  • Experience with EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of cloud environments and cloud security concepts across Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills with experience collecting and analysing evidence during security incidents.

  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other security professionals.

  • Strong ownership, collaboration, and communication skills.

  • Fluency in English (internal working language)

  • C2 Fluency in German (required for client communication)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience developing scripts, tools, or automations to support investigations and response activities.

  • Experience conducting technical security research.

  • Knowledge of threat actors and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

  • Experience working in a CERT, CSIRT, MDR, or DFIR environment.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…)

  • Thursday socials to stay connected

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days

About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.

 

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

 

At Eye, you’ll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.
