jobs.title: Supply Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Location: Any MSF office*

Contract: 100%

Duration: 12 months

Starting date: 04th of January 2027

Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate.

The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables.

The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst.

Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables.

Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba).

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them.

1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs

a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps

b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements

c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives

2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis

a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems

b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams

c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods

3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making

a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned

b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights

c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise

4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations

a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis

b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…)

c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences

5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables

a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines)

b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working

c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery

6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed

a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team

b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously

c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities:

  • Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed.

  • Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment.

SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.


Education

  • Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential)

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential)

  • Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential)

  • Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential)

  • Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable)

  • Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable)

Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time

  • Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision

  • Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management

  • Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment

  • Drive for change, improvement and innovation

Languages

  • Fluent spoken and written English (essential)

  • Good command of French (strongly desirable)

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures.

jobs.title: Head of Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

  • Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN.

What Great Looks Like

  • KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN.

  • KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers.

  • Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable.

  • Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved.

  • KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering.

  • Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to.

  • Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon.

  • Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology

Requirements

  • Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations.

  • Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery.

jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Senior CSM at 1Password, you own and strategically manage a portfolio of customers – driving value realization, revenue retention, and expansion outcomes that consistently exceed expectations. You operate with full commercial autonomy: advancing expansion opportunities independently, engaging VP and C-suite stakeholders as a trusted advisor, and managing complex renewals without escalation. Beyond your own book, you raise the bar for the team through mentorship, playbook contributions, and peer enablement.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years in a customer-facing, consultative, or technical role in SaaS – Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or IT/security leadership.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes; experience recognized with performance distinction is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run executive business reviews with VP and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Background in cybersecurity, IAM, identity security, or enterprise IT preferred; former 1Password power user is a strong plus.

  • Strategic success planning and multi-threaded stakeholder management across a complex portfolio.

  • Commercial acumen: independently qualifies, advances, and documents expansion opportunities; manages negotiations without oversight.

  • Designs and applies AI-assisted workflows to commercial execution; documents use cases in a shareable format.

  • Strong Gainsight and Salesforce hygiene; consistent forecasting discipline.

  • Highly autonomous; manages complex accounts without requiring managerial direction.

  • Commercial thinker who connects customer outcomes to expansion potential naturally.

  • Strong executive presence – adapts messaging across technical, operational, and C-suite audiences.

  • Elevates teammates through knowledge sharing and informal mentorship.

What you can expect:

Own and Grow Your Book of Business

  • Independently manage a portfolio of moderately to highly complex accounts – adapting success plans to each customer’s context without manager guidance.

  • Maintain full success plan coverage; produce documented best practices and playbooks, applied broadly across accounts with measurable KPI improvement.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate renewal risks; close risk CTAs with a high rate of success within defined timeframes.

Drive Adoption & Value Realization

  • Achieve strong Executive Sponsor attendance in EBRs across segments; EBRs are value-driven, data-backed, and consistently advance renewal confidence.

  • Maintain commercial intelligence across strategic accounts – budget cycles, org changes, compliance mandates, and stack rationalization.

  • Translate advanced 1Password capabilities into clear outcomes for VP and C-suite stakeholders; tie adoption to measurable ROI and long-term advocacy.

Lead Revenue Retention & Expansion

  • Achieve strong amendment and renewal upsell win rates; proactively source and advance expansion opportunities with documented context.

  • Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end.

Operate with Strategic Rigor

  • Manage commercial objections, renewal negotiations, and competitive conversations independently – without escalation for standard to complex scenarios.

  • Build and present business cases to customer champions; advance deals with enough depth to move through the pipeline with AE alignment.

Act as a Trusted Security Advisor

  • Deep working knowledge of the full 1Password product suite; design tailored success journeys connecting feature adoption to measurable business outcomes.

  • Incorporate regulatory context, breach patterns, and competitive dynamics into EBRs with confidence.

  • Design and share AI-assisted workflows with teammates in a replicable, documented format.

Collaborate & Enable

  • Lead joint account planning with your AE; cited by AEs as a proactive commercial collaborator who improves deal outcomes.

  • Mentor Level B CSMs through call shadowing, ad hoc coaching, or onboarding support.

  • Lead or co-lead cross-team initiatives; contribute tools or improvements adopted by peers.

Month 1 – Onboarding & Foundation

  • Develop fluency in 1Password’s full product suite, CS methodology, and commercial motion.

  • By the end of Month 1, you will independently manage customer touchpoints and demonstrate clear understanding of renewal drivers across your portfolio.

Month 3 – Portfolio Ownership

  • Full ownership of your book with consistent EBR cadence and expansion sourcing.

  • By Month 3, you are meeting key performance targets and expansion leads are flowing to Sales with documented context.

Month 6 – Strategic Impact

  • Operating at full commercial autonomy; contributing to team practices and mentoring peers.

  • By Month 6, you are achieving top-tier customer satisfaction and recognized as a reliable commercial collaborator by your AE and cross-functional partners.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £73,000 GBP and £106,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

P3 is a long-term investor, manager and developer of European warehouse properties with more than 10.2 million m² of assets under management and land bank of 1.7 million m² of future gross lettable area for further development.

P3 has commercial activities in 11 countries and has been investing and developing in European markets for over two decades. And because we care about our customers and communities where we operate, we develop environmentally friendly, sustainable warehouses to the highest international standards.

Headquartered in Prague, P3 employs more than 320 people with 25+ nationalities across 11 offices in key European cities, offering integrated development, asset and property management services. P3 has an investment grade BBB credit rating by Standard & Poor’s.

Attracting the right talents is key for our future. We are looking for ambitious and passionate experts who can help us make P3 THE leading logistics warehouse provider in Europe.


OUR CULTURE

Our company values - Integrity, Teamwork, Excellence, Ambition - are embedded deeply within the organisation, and guide our steps every single day. P3’s size and stability enable us to take a global view and yet at the same time we are just the right size to maintain our agile and flexible approach on local real estate markets.

Together, we create an environment that encourages personal growth because we know we are successful mainly thanks to the people who make P3. We recognise and reward outstanding performance and motivate people to contribute to our mutual goals and turn their good ideas into great outcomes. We encourage people to have ownership, make decisions and accept responsibility for them.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

A Senior Asset Manager who would be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of P3’s logistics real estate portfolio in France. The role focuses on strategic asset planning, value creation, leasing performance, capital investment management, and stakeholder coordination across the full lifecycle of the assets.

The role is set to drive asset-level business plans, executes value-enhancing initiatives, manages leasing strategies, and coordinates cross-functional teams to optimize financial, technical, and operational performance while aligning with P3’s overall investment strategy.


SOME OF THE INTERESTING CHALLENGES AHEAD OF YOU

Asset Strategy & Investment

  • Develop and execute asset business plans aligned with P3’s investment strategy, driving NOI, occupancy and long-term value.
  • Identify value-creation opportunities: leasing optimisation, repositioning, redevelopment and cost efficiencies.
  • Perform hold/sell analyses and support acquisitions and disposals.
  • Prepare investment memos, financial models and recommendations for the Investment Committee.

Financial Performance & Reporting

  • Own the financial performance of assigned assets, including revenue growth and cost control.
  • Prepare budgets, reforecasts and long-term business plans, and track performance against KPIs and underwriting.
  • Manage valuation inputs and support external valuations.
  • Report on asset and portfolio performance to senior management in line with internal governance.

Leasing & Tenant Management

  • Define leasing strategies to maximise occupancy, tenant quality and rental growth.

Du hast genug Python ausgeliefert, um zu wissen, dass der Code nie der schwierige Teil war — sondern die Entscheidungen drumherum, und genau die sollst du bei uns verantworten

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unsere Customer-Lifecycle-Management-(CLM)-Plattform weiterentwickeln — du baust skalierbare, performante Backend-Services und prägst die technische Roadmap strategisch mit, mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Saubere, wartbare APIs und serverseitige Logik eigenständig konzipieren und implementieren — das Rückgrat unserer Webanwendungen
  • Komplexe Datenflüsse verantworten und die Kommunikation zwischen SQL- und NoSQL-Systemen schnell und zuverlässig halten
  • Den technischen Lifecycle vollständig verantworten — vom Code über Container-Umgebungen (Docker) bis zu CI/CD-Pipelines sorgst du für einen reibungslosen, sicheren Betrieb
  • Die technische Seite der Produktarbeit führen — gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team übersetzt du Nutzeranforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen
  • Qualität hochhalten — du verantwortest Code-Reviews und optimierst Deployment-Prozesse in unserer Linux-basierten Infrastruktur

Das bringst du mit

  • 5+ Jahre professionelle Python-Entwicklung mit Fokus auf Webentwicklung mit Django, FastAPI oder Flask (mindestens eines davon)
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL- und NoSQL-Umgebungen (z. B. MongoDB)
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit End-to-End-CI/CD-Ökosystemen (z. B. Git, Jenkins, Sonar, Nexus)
  • Professioneller Umgang mit Docker — Aufbau, Wartung und Optimierung von Images
  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von Linux-Umgebungen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, dazu das Entwickler-Englisch, das du im Alltag brauchst — Doku lesen, Code und Kommentare schreiben, Arbeiten in einem internationalen Tech-Umfeld
  • Lust darauf, zwei Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Büro in Mannheim zu sein – die anderen drei Tage gestaltest du von zu Hause

Nice to have

  • Frontend-Erfahrung (JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js) — wenn du möchtest, kannst du an modernen Web-Interfaces mitwirken und Daten und UI perfekt zusammenspielen lassen

jobs.title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

 

We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces.

  • Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development.

  • Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation.

  • Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance.

  • Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware.

  • Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation.

  • Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements

  • Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities.

  • Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior.

  • Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment.

 

What we would love to see from you

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems.

  • Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures.

  • Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent.

  • Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models.

  • Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response.

  • Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry.

  • Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial.

 

Skills and Behaviours

  • Methodical and structured approach to problem solving.

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor.

  • Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale.

  • Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve.

  • Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Switzerland
Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Suisse
Mid Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
Studytube is een Nederlands SaaS-bedrijf met een alles-in-één leerplatform (LMS en LXP) voor Learning & Development en HR. Als Mid Market Account Executive verkoop je dit platform aan organisaties met 250 tot 1000 medewerkers. Je bent eigenaar van het hele salestraject, van de discovery tot het getekende contract.

Je hebt de eerste jaren in sales achter de rug en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen. Je wilt aan tafel zitten met directeuren, oplossingen op maat bedenken en deals sluiten die echt iets betekenen voor een organisatie. Bij Studytube krijg je daar alle ruimte voor, met begeleiding die je sneller beter maakt.

Waarom dit werk ertoe doet

Er worden miljarden uitgegeven aan opleidingen en organisaties investeren significant in opleiden. Toch mist meer dan de helft van de medewerkers nog steeds de skills die ze nodig hebben. Middelgrote organisaties voelen dat sterk: ze groeien snel, maar hebben vaak geen groot L&D-team. Studytube helpt hen leren slim te organiseren en af te stemmen op hun doelen. Jij laat zien hoe dat werkt voor hun situatie.

Jouw rol

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor nieuwe business in het mid-market-segment: organisaties met 250 tot 1.000 medewerkers in uiteenlopende sectoren. Je werkt met deals rond €3k MRR en een cyclus van 4 tot 6 maanden. Je bent eigenaar van het hele traject, van de eerste discovery tot het getekende contract.

  • Je bouwt je portfolio uit. Je combineert leads uit marketing met je eigen outbound en kiest bewust de organisaties waar Studytube het meeste verschil maakt.

  • Je verkoopt consultatief. Je doorgrondt de leer- en bedrijfsdoelen van een klant en vertaalt die naar een oplossing die ook over drie jaar nog werkt.

  • Je regisseert het aankooptraject. Je schakelt tussen HR, L&D en directie en weet wie je wanneer betrekt. Je houdt tempo zonder te pushen.

  • Je bent de stem van de klant. Wat je in gesprekken hoort, vertaal je naar inzichten voor Marketing, Product en Customer Success.


Wat jij meebrengt

  • 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring in B2B-sales, bij voorkeur in software of SaaS.

  • Je hebt zelfstandig deals gesloten van tussen de €25k en €75k ARR of meer, en je kunt laten zien hoe je je target hebt gehaald.

  • Je verkoopt consultatief: je stelt eerst de goede vragen en komt pas daarna met een oplossing.

  • Je praat net zo makkelijk met een L&D-adviseur als met een algemeen directeur.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

  • Je wordt gedreven door targets en wilt winnen. Successen deel je met het team.

  • Je wilt snel groeien en vraagt zelf om feedback.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een beloning die meegroeit met je resultaat. Basissalaris van €70k, OTE van €115k, het variabel deel is zonder plafond en er is een pensioenregeling.

  • Een duidelijk groeipad. Van Mid Market naar Enterprise AE, of richting een teamleadrol. We laten je zien wat je daarvoor nodig hebt en helpen je er te komen.

  • Ontwikkeling die je sneller beter maakt. Een persoonlijke coach, trainingen via de Studytube Level-Up Academy en dealcoaching van ervaren collega’s.

  • Ondersteuning om te verkopen. Leads uit DemandGen, een Solution Engineer voor complexere demo’s en een product met sterke referenties in jouw segment.

  • Ruimte om je eigen agenda in te delen. Drie dagen op kantoor, de rest bepaal je zelf. We sturen op resultaat, niet op aanwezigheid.

  • Een team en kantoor waar je graag bent. Ambitieuze collega’s die successen samen vieren, een eigen gym, verzorgde lunches en regelmatige teamuitjes.


Over Studytube

Studytube begon in 2011 bij twee rechtenstudenten. Ze bouwden een studietool voor zichzelf en ontdekten hoeveel beter mensen leren als het leren op hén is afgestemd. Dat inzicht is nog steeds de kern van wat we doen. Onze missie: het volledige potentieel van mensen ontsluiten met persoonlijk leren, op grote schaal.

Ons leerplatform combineert een LMS, een leeromgeving met AI-aanbevelingen, een Skill Navigator en een marketplace met meer dan 1.000 opleiders. Meer dan 700+ organisaties werken met Studytube, waaronder bol, a.s.r., CZ, ManpowerGroup en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s bouwen we aan onze internationale groei, met één doel: het platform voor professionele ontwikkeling worden waar Europa op vertrouwt.

Pennylane’s growth and international expansion are increasing the volume of suppliers, contracts and renewals.

Your work will help control costs and risks, simplify supplier management and improve the internal purchasing experience.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a new colleague to join our Systems & Infrastructure team.

In this role, you’ll work across the full WTSS IT infrastructure. And because of what we do, that infrastructure is genuinely interesting. It’s a broad technical role where Linux, Windows, networking, scripting and many different types of hardware all come together.

Our infrastructure is essential to our daily operation. As a FinTech partner for banks, we run real-time banking and payment journeys. Day and night, we execute tests for our clients across all kinds of hardware — PCs, laptops, smartphones and tablets.

That means your work directly contributes to our technical reliability, continuity and security.

Together with two other colleagues, you’ll be responsible for keeping our environment running, maintaining it and continuously improving it. The goal is that you can fully cover for one another when needed. So we’re looking for someone who can work independently, keeps a clear overview and actually enjoys understanding multiple layers of infrastructure.

Who is WTSS?

Banks process millions of transactions every day. When something goes wrong, issues need to be found, understood and resolved quickly. That’s where we come in.

WTSS is an independent FinTech partner for international banks. We act as a safe, patient and risk-free ‘pilot customer’, so banks don’t have to test new or critical journeys on their actual customers.

We design structured test journeys — both manual and automated — across many different environments to detect issues early and help our clients understand what is really happening.

From our HQ in Rotterdam, a small and highly technical team of around 20 people works for some of the world’s largest banks.

We call ourselves ethical techies: curious technical people who enjoy breaking things in order to make them better. Incidents don’t scare us; they make us curious.

What you’ll be doing

This role is quite different from the average systems or infrastructure position. You won’t be one small part of a large DevOps transformation. The work is much more hands-on and technical — a bit like infrastructure work used to be, but without the slow-moving legacy environment.

You’ll be working on things such as:

  • Managing both Linux and Windows environments

  • Scripting with Bash and PowerShell, and improving automation processes

  • Managing and improving our network and firewall environment, including OPNsense firewalls with high-availability pairs and UniFi switches

  • Working with virtualisation and backup environments, including Proxmox VE clusters, Ceph storage and Proxmox Backup Server

In short: real, hands-on systems and infrastructure work. If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving technical problems and getting your hands dirty, your analytical brain will feel right at home here.


Do you love technology as much as we do?

You’ll join a team of people who genuinely enjoy tech. We’re the ones our families call when the printer won’t connect or the Wi-Fi starts acting strange. Some of us install a new operating system on our own laptop just for fun. On a Saturday. Voluntarily.

If you have that same curiosity for new tools, technology and figuring out how things work, we’d love to hear from you.

What you bring

  • HBO-level working and thinking ability. Your exact degree matters less to us than how you think and how quickly you learn.

  • A technical mindset that looks for solutions and enjoys solving problems, even under pressure.

  • A careful and structured way of working: you follow steps accurately and quickly notice small differences or anomalies.

  • Curiosity about hardware, banking, payments, security or FinTech is a big plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary

  • A role you simply don’t come across very often

  • Plenty of variety in a growing, tech-minded and no-nonsense team

  • A solid pension plan, travel allowance and work-from-home allowance

Are you passionate about transforming how large organizations learn and develop? Imagine being the trusted advisor to some of the world's most prestigious brands, guiding them through learning journeys that change how their HR teams perform.

At AIHR, we are looking for a full-time Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience) who will turn every learning initiative into a clear story of performance improvement and organization-wide impact. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the HR industry!

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world's market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, including companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. We strive to provide the world's best courses and excellent support to our customers, while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

As a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility, with countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-tech experience), you enable AIHR's largest B2B clients to run successful learning initiatives and build a culture of learning. At AIHR, we call this role Learning Consultant rather than Customer Success Manager, because your focus goes beyond account management. You act as a strategic advisor, guiding customers in designing and implementing learning journeys that drive measurable impact.

You own a dedicated portfolio of our largest and most complex enterprise customers, from onboarding to adoption, all the way to renewal. What does that look like in practice?

  • Strategic partnership: You build strong, multi-level relationships with senior stakeholders (CHROs, VPs and Heads of HR, Heads of L&D) and make sure AIHR stays aligned with their business objectives.

  • Joint Impact Plans: You diagnose customer needs and co-create a Joint Impact Plan that connects our learning solutions to their business goals, with clear metrics to show return on investment (ROI).

  • Enterprise onboarding and adoption: You onboard large customers and design the change management and communication strategy that embeds the AIHR platform in their learning culture.

  • Portfolio health: You take full ownership of your portfolio's health. You use the Customer Health Score in HubSpot to spot risks early and act before they turn into churn.

  • Commercial partnership: You co-own commercial goals with our Growth Account Executives. Your deep customer knowledge shapes the renewal and expansion strategy for your accounts.

  • Team excellence: You mentor other Learning Consultants and help develop the team's best practices and playbooks.

You are successful when your clients' learners show improved work performance, not just when they complete a program, and when AIHR's impact makes them want to grow the partnership. Ultimately, your client's success is your success. Your goal is to develop their learners into T-shaped HR professionals.

On a typical day

You arrive at our beautiful office in Rotterdam or Amsterdam, grab a coffee, and after a quick chat with colleagues, you fire up your MacBook to check your calendar. You start by reviewing your portfolio in HubSpot, our single source of truth, paying close attention to the Customer Health Score to prioritize your actions for the day.

Your morning starts with a Quarterly Strategic Check-in with the VP of HR at one of your key accounts. You present a clear story of their progress and ROI, using learning and engagement data you analyzed with the help of an AI skill. Afterward, you have a 1-1 with your manager, Emilie, to build a multithreading strategy for an account where you only have one champion. Later, you spend time with Dieter, one of our superstar SMEs, to plan a thought leadership session for your customer's HR leadership team.

After a delicious lunch in the office with the team, you dedicate time to a new enterprise client, Ahold Delhaize, documenting their business objectives to build their Joint Impact Plan and rollout communication strategy. You then join Jessica, our Growth Account Executive, to align on the commercial strategy for an upcoming multi-year renewal, so you show up as one team. Next, you sit down with a newer Learning Consultant to prepare a difficult conversation with one of their customers.

Before the day ends, you contribute to an internal project, sharing customer feedback about new features and improvements with the product team, including insights you summarized by feeding call transcripts into Gemini.

To wrap up the week, you join the team for a drink during our weekly activity, celebrating joint successes and getting to know new colleagues.


Who you are

Helping large clients roll out complex learning initiatives is nothing new for you. You've done it many times, and you know your value goes further. You are the strategic advisor senior HR leaders call first, because you know that when they experience impact with AIHR, they see real skill development, better performance, and a lasting change in their learning culture.

Furthermore, you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role, such as a (Learning) Consultant, L&D Professional, or Customer Success Manager, specifically within the Ed-Tech or E-learning industry;

  • A proven track record of managing a portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts and prioritizing to maximize impact;

  • Demonstrable experience building and maintaining relationships with multiple senior stakeholders at the same account (multithreading), up to C-level;

  • Strong English proficiency, with the ability to discuss proposals, write clear copy, and push back on or challenge senior customers constructively;

  • A natural ability to ask insightful follow-up questions to diagnose core challenges and co-create solutions with clients;

  • Expertise in adult learning principles, change management, and designing effective L&D strategies for large organizations;

  • The ability to think commercially, identify growth opportunities, and connect HR initiatives to overall business performance and ROI;

  • Strong skills in using data from tools like HubSpot and Excel to derive insights and present a clear story of progress and value to executives;

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for tasks like analysis, content creation, and workflow automation. This is essential;

  • A genuine desire to help develop colleagues and raise the capabilities of the whole team.

To set you up for success in this role, we are specifically looking for candidates with external-facing customer experience (not in-house L&D roles) and a background in education, e-learning, or ed-tech. We believe many skills can be learned on the job, but these experiences are essential. They provide the foundation you need to drive impact in our environment.

We offer

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue.  En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.
L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Tes missions :

  • Concevoir et développer des solutions d’IA à forte valeur ajoutée pour tes clients, de la conception technique jusqu’au déploiement et au monitoring en production.

  • Intervenir sur des projets variés d’IA, aussi bien en IA traditionnelle (détection d’objets, prévision des ventes, etc.) qu’en IA générative (RAG, agents IA, etc.), en fonction des besoins des clients.

  • Garantir la qualité et la livraison des solutions dans les délais impartis, tout en contribuant à la progression de ton équipe et à l’amélioration continue des pratiques.

  • Travailler sur des projets dans des secteurs variés, tels que la santé, la fintech, le retail ou encore le secteur public.

  • Évoluer au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, généralement composée d’un Engineering Manager pour t’accompagner et te challenger, d’un à trois AI Engineers et d’un Product Manager.

  • Contribuer au développement de notre expertise technique, en interne à travers des formations et des initiatives, et en externe via des conférences, des articles techniques et des échanges avec nos clients.

  • Participer activement au développement de la communauté tech de Theodo Data en partageant tes connaissances et en lançant de nouvelles initiatives : guildes, formations, retours d’expérience, etc.

  • Évoluer dans une culture fortement inspirée du Lean, fondée sur l’amélioration continue, l’apprentissage collectif et la recherche permanente de valeur pour le client.


    • Ton profil :

  • Tu es animé par la recherche de la qualité, aussi bien dans le code que dans la méthodologie, tout en privilégiant des solutions pragmatiques qui répondent concrètement aux besoins de tes clients.

  • Tu as une expérience sur au moins un hyperscaler (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript / Node.js)
jobs.description:
Hi, we are Storyteq! Storyteq helps marketing and creative teams in top brands scale their creative production and gain control over their marketing campaigns. Through our platform, our clients streamline campaign workflows, automate their creative production through templates and AI, and activate engaging campaigns that go to market faster. We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together.

About the job:

About the job You will be part of the Templating domain, where we enable global enterprises to scale up their content creation efficiently. Content comes in from sources like Photoshop, Figma and After Effects, or is designed in our AI-enabled, web-based editor, and then taken to the next level. You will work directly with other developers, designers, quality engineers, DevOps engineers and product owners to deliver the best platform for our users. This is a full stack role with TypeScript and Node.js at its core. Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. The team works with strong goals and a good balance of product and engineering roadmap work, so we keep both our technology and our product on track.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and ship robust backend services and frontends with real product impact
  • Ensure systems are scalable, performant and easy to maintain
  • Model business domains into clean, performant data structures
  • Collaborate across teams to integrate services and deliver end-to-end value
  • Coach and mentor other engineers on best practices to help them grow
  • Collaborate with other engineers and lead technical delivery on initiatives within a domain or project
  • Lead by example in engineering excellence, pragmatism and shared ownership

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Must have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on, production experience delivering full-stack products with TypeScript and JavaScript, with Node.js as your main backend
  • A positive attitude to AI, backed by experience: you already use AI tools and agents in your daily work, and you want to push the team further with them. If you are sceptical of AI, or would rather protect your team from it, this isn’t the right job for you.

Core:

  • Hands-on experience with Vue.js (or another modern frontend framework), and no fear of working in the frontend
  • Solid experience designing and integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Proficiency in data modeling and working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Comfortable working in monorepo environments and modular architectures
  • Familiar with testing practices, performance tuning and scalable design principles
  • Confident in making architectural decisions and communicating trade-offs
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • You are proactive, result-driven, and excited to work in a fast-growing tech scale-up

What makes you senior for this role:

  • You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see work through from problem to production.
  • You make the architectural calls in your domain and explain the trade-offs clearly.
  • You make the people around you better through reviews, mentoring and the standards you set.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with PHP (Laravel). Part of our platform runs on it, but it is not what this job is about
  • Experience building features on top of LLMs or other AI services
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, DevOps and public cloud (like GCP)

We Value Diversity:
We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality. 

We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation but the wider industry too.

jobs.title: Customer Education
jobs.description:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000+ paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

Peec ships something new almost every week. Most customers hear about it late, and some never do. We're hiring a Customer Education Manager to own how customers learn Peec. You'll own the product docs, the changelog, product updates and in-app communication, and turn every release into something a busy marketer understands in a minute.

You'll sit in product marketing and report to our founding product marketer. You'll work every day with product managers and engineers to understand what's shipping, with customer success to see where customers get stuck, and with the growth team to see what actually changes how people use the product.

What you'll do

  • Own the product docs. Rebuild them around the jobs customers come to do, not around the menu. Keep them current with every release, and make them easy to read for people and for the AI assistants our customers now ask first.

  • Run the changelog and product updates. Every release gets a clear entry the day it ships. You write the regular product update and the announcement for bigger launches, and decide what deserves which.

  • Write in-app communication. You write the copy for announcements, tooltips, empty states, onboarding steps and feature nudges. The growth team runs the nudges themselves (who sees what, when, and the tests); you make sure every message is clear, accurate and sounds like one product.

  • Make product content that teaches. Short how-to videos, walkthroughs, use-case guides and templates that get a new user from signup to their first useful insight, and an existing customer to the feature they're missing.

  • Get in early. Sit with product and engineering before launch, early enough to shape naming, setup and the first-run experience, not just document them afterwards.

  • Fix questions at the source. Read support tickets and customer calls, find the questions we keep answering, and make sure the product, docs or messaging answer them before anyone has to ask.

  • Measure what you ship. Track docs usage, support deflection and feature adoption after each update. Keep what works, cut what doesn't.

What we're looking for

  • You come from product. Product management, product ops, technical writing, solutions or support engineering, or customer success with a strong product bent. You learn software deeply by using it and can get a straight answer from a busy engineer.

  • You've owned docs, a help center or release communication for a B2B SaaS product. Show us a before and after.

  • You write simply. You can explain a complex feature in three sentences to someone who has never seen it, and cut a page in half without losing anything. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear.

  • You like to ship a lot. Many small, useful pieces over one perfect one, and you care as much about keeping them up to date as about publishing them.

  • You're comfortable with data. Given adoption numbers, you can say whether a piece of content worked.

  • You use AI to draft, research and keep content in sync with the product. You build the systems that other teams can plug into to ensure consistency across every touchpoint.

  • You work well across product, engineering, customer success and marketing, make decisions and ship.

Bonus points

  • You built a docs or customer education function from scratch, first in seat.

  • You've worked in martech, SEO, analytics or a data platform, so you already know our customers' world.

  • You make short product videos and screen recordings yourself.

  • You've written in-app messages or product emails in tools like Customer.io, Intercom, Appcues or Pendo.

  • You know how to structure docs so AI assistants read and cite them correctly.

  • You write well in German or French as well as English.

Compensation: €80K – €95K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Data Platform Lead
jobs.description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Klanten willen zien wat hun leren oplevert, de business wil sturen op cijfers die kloppen en onze AI-ambities staan of vallen met goede data. Daarom zoeken we een Data Platform Lead die het fundament bouwt waar heel Studytube op draait.

De rol

Data werkt bij Studytube als hub-and-spoke. Jij leidt de hub: het gedeelde dataplatform binnen Engineering, met infrastructuur, pipelines, het lakehouse en de gedeelde datamodellen. De spokes zitten in de business, van finance en product tot Customer Success en GTM. Zij bouwen de analyses en dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt, vindbaar is en meebeweegt met het product.

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering en geeft leiding aan de data engineer. Op termijn breiden we het team uit met een analytics engineer. Je bent een player-coach: je zet de koers uit en bouwt zelf mee.

Wat je doet

  • Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform en de architectuur, en stelt de roadmap op samen met de spokes.

  • Je zorgt voor één versie van de waarheid. De spokes bepalen wat een actieve learner is, jij zorgt dat die definitie één keer gebouwd wordt en overal hetzelfde getal oplevert.

  • Je bouwt het platform als product: self-service, documentatie en heldere afspraken, zodat analisten zelfstandig vooruit kunnen.

  • Je legt het datafundament voor AI, voor features in het product en voor interne toepassingen op bedrijfsdata. Je team bouwt zelf sneller met AI-tools.

  • Je neemt het Databricks-platform over van een externe partij, inclusief een high-security omgeving, en denkt mee over de toekomst van onze stack.

  • Je richt governance in het platform in: toegang, datakwaliteit, lineage, retentie en verwijdering, GDPR-proof.

  • Je weegt verzoeken van de spokes tegen elkaar af en legt je keuzes uit, ook als het antwoord nee is.

  • Je coacht het team, werft mee aan de uitbreiding en spreidt kennis, zodat niets van één persoon afhangt.


Je hebt eerder een dataplatform opgezet of volwassen gemaakt, het liefst in een scale-up. Je bent technisch diep, maar denkt vanuit je gebruikers: een analist die een tabel niet vindt of niet vertrouwt, is voor jou een platformprobleem. Je legt trade-offs uit aan zowel de directie als een developer.

Je bent pragmatisch, nieuwsgierig naar wat AI verandert aan het vak en haalt energie uit het laten groeien van anderen.

Must-haves

  • 8+ jaar ervaring in data, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar als lead van een team of platform.

  • Hands-on ervaring in de hele keten: een cloud data platform en pipelines, en SQL, dbt en Python in productie.

  • Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure.

  • Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code en CI/CD met GitHub.

  • Dimensioneel modelleren, een semantische laag en data governance in de praktijk.

  • Praktische ervaring met AI-tools in data-ontwikkeling of met data voor AI-toepassingen.

  • Stakeholders tot op directieniveau meenemen in een roadmap.

  • Engels op professioneel niveau; Nederlands is een pré.

  • Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB).

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, data contracts, B2B SaaS of edtech, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen.

Stack

Snowflake, Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker.

Wat we bieden

  • Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data bij Studytube neer te zetten.

  • Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag.

  • 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube.

  • € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek.

  • LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding.

  • Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest.

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden.

E. Doorontwikkeling & modernisering

  • Meedenken over toekomstige architectuur (API-first, cloud-ready).

  • Voorstellen doen voor innovatie binnen het tandtechniekdomein.

Als Data Scientist maak je onderdeel uit van het Business Intelligence team. Het BI-team ondersteunt alle labels binnen de MSPS Groep. Het huidige BI team  bestaat uit drie BI-specialisten, een Data Scientist en een Product Owner. Het BI team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Finance en wordt samen met de afdeling Business Control aangestuurd door de manager Business Control & Business Intelligence.  Samen met je directe collega’s van BC&BI en de stakeholders binnen MSPS werk je aan datagedreven oplossingen die directe impact hebben op de organisatie.
